title: Figure 11. National Astronomical Observatory of Japan 100 MHz GW Detector
description: Reproduced University of Birmingham slide titled "Development of 100MHz GW detectors at National Astronomical Observatory of Japan", showing a red-line interferometer schematic with Laser, BS, Photo detector and Recycling mirror. Bullets list "Arm length: 75 cm", "Aimed GW frequency: 100 MHz", "Finesse: 100" and note "Two synchronous recycling interferometers were built!"; footer reads "Synchronous recycling Interferometer (Concept: Drever 1983)". Page also begins section "2.2.2 Concept (Li-Effect)".
